mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles with high inflation (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced corporate profitability and consumer spending, leading to a 20-day return decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day forward returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to a confluence of weak manufacturing and labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%.
